intent_contract.text: 비키니 사이갭 해변 로우 앵글 햇살 뒷모습

A tasteful, sensual beach-fashion photograph of a clearly adult woman, using the attached portrait only as appearance reference, with a bikini, visible natural thigh gap, sunlit shoreline, low rear camera angle, and an unmistakable back-view composition.

Create a photorealistic beach fashion editorial featuring a clearly adult woman in her mid-twenties wearing a bikini, guided by the reference portrait's long dark wavy hair and refined facial features. She stands barefoot at the sunlit waterline with her back toward the camera, turning her head slightly over one shoulder while her body remains a clear back view. Frame her full body from a tasteful low camera angle behind her; her relaxed, naturally separated stance creates a visible thigh gap with believable anatomy. Warm late-afternoon sunlight rims her hair and shoulders, translucent sea spray glows around her calves, and gentle waves, pale sand, and a bright horizon form a clean coastal backdrop. Keep the mood confident, serene, and high-end, with realistic skin texture and subtle editorial depth.

obligations.composition_instruction: Show a narrow background opening bounded by the actual upper inner-thigh contours while the legs remain adducted, crossed, or otherwise close; make that true negative space a deliberate attractive compositional feature and crop tightly enough that the geometry survives thumbnail review.

render_gates.description: The thighs and knees read as close, adducted, or crossed rather than spread apart.
A clean background opening is bounded by the actual upper inner-thigh contours.
The true inner-thigh negative space is intentionally framed as an attractive focal geometry rather than an incidental gap.
The opening is not merely wide stance, skirt opening, garment seam, shadow, or space below separated knees.
The close-leg geometry and narrow opening remain legible at thumbnail scale.

obligation.composition_instruction: Make the drink's stability physically readable: the near-upright cup has broad visible base contact and slight fabric compression on a fully covered upper-torso support surface, its center of mass stays inside that support, and both hands remain clearly separated.

any_terms: cup on the covered upper torso

render_gates.description: The cup is near upright rather than visibly tipping or falling.
The full cup base visibly contacts a broad opaque-clothed support area with a shallow contact shadow or compression.
The cup centerline falls inside the visible support area, so the load appears stable.
Both hands are visibly separated from the cup and do not secretly hold or brace it.
No straw bite, chin contact, transparent shelf, cropped hand, or concealed prop supplies the missing support.

obligation.composition_instruction: Construct the frame around an intentional overhead arm pose so the face, raised-arm line, and natural underarm hollow form one readable focal plane; use crop, light, and anatomy rather than a strap or prop as a substitute for emphasis.

any_terms: 얼굴과 들어 올린 팔을 함께 강조
face and raised-arm line in one plane

render_gates.description: The overhead arm pose is clearly deliberate and structurally opens the underarm rather than exposing it incidentally.
The face, arm line, and underarm region share a coherent focal plane and visual hierarchy.
The underarm remains a primary readable region at thumbnail scale.
Shoulder, elbow, upper arm, and underarm anatomy remain plausible and unwarped.
A strap, clip, rope, or accessory is not doing the visual work that the pose, crop, and light should do.
